latest_release.name: DBDelve 0.7.2
latest_release.body:
Missing something? [Request it or upvote others' ideas](https://github.com/ShayanAbbas1/dbdelve/discussions/42).


## What's Changed
* feat(editor): complete each dialect's built-in functions and values by @ShayanAbbas1 in https://github.com/ShayanAbbas1/dbdelve/pull/227
* feat(explorer): open only the active schema and remember sidebar folds by @ShayanAbbas1 in https://github.com/ShayanAbbas1/dbdelve/pull/228
* ci: bump the actions group with 2 updates by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/ShayanAbbas1/dbdelve/pull/219
* feat(connections): sign in with a password command's output by @ShayanAbbas1 in https://github.com/ShayanAbbas1/dbdelve/pull/229
* fix(duckdb): install extensions on DuckDB 2.0 by @DrPandemic in https://github.com/ShayanAbbas1/dbdelve/pull/231
* feat(update): update in one click on macOS, and install without clearing quarantine by @ShayanAbbas1 in https://github.com/ShayanAbbas1/dbdelve/pull/230
* fix(theme): honour the OS "always show scrollbars" setting by @Koril33 in https://github.com/ShayanAbbas1/dbdelve/pull/233
* feat(update): update in one click on Linux, and install with the same one-liner by @ShayanAbbas1 in https://github.com/ShayanAbbas1/dbdelve/pull/239
* feat(ssh): log in with a key's passphrase, kept in the keychain by @ShayanAbbas1 in https://github.com/ShayanAbbas1/dbdelve/pull/243
* fix(insert): put a field back to its default, and show what an empty one sends by @ShayanAbbas1 in https://github.com/ShayanAbbas1/dbdelve/pull/244
* perf(welcome): fade the contours with a gradient stroke, not a mask by @Peng-Rao in https://github.com/ShayanAbbas1/dbdelve/pull/246
* feat(update): update in one click on Windows, from the installer or the zip by @ShayanAbbas1 in https://github.com/ShayanAbbas1/dbdelve/pull/249
* feat(editor): alias completed tables and suggest JOIN conditions by @ShayanAbbas1 in https://github.com/ShayanAbbas1/dbdelve/pull/253
* feat(editor): run statements dbdelve can't parse without asking, when opted in by @ShayanAbbas1 in https://github.com/ShayanAbbas1/dbdelve/pull/254

## New Contributors
* @DrPandemic made their first contribution in https://github.com/ShayanAbbas1/dbdelve/pull/231
* @Koril33 made their first contribution in https://github.com/ShayanAbbas1/dbdelve/pull/233
* @Peng-Rao made their first contribution in https://github.com/ShayanAbbas1/dbdelve/pull/246

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/ShayanAbbas1/dbdelve/compare/v0.7.1...v0.7.2
